**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

§ 14.3 applies New York substantive law — the playbook's preferred position. No arbitration provision exists in the document, and no foreign or vendor-home venue is imposed, so there is no walk-away exposure. Related mechanics (§ 14.4 jury waiver, § 14.14 two-year limitation) are mutual and neutral for this rule.

Noted but not flagged: the clause is silent on venue and does not expressly confer exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County. That is a missing sub-mechanic short of the preferred wording rather than a material failure, so we would only add exclusive New York County venue if § 14.3 is reopened for other reasons.
